rationale: retained-ui-kernel: pointer_dispatch gains delivery functions for key and text input, modifier-key changes, focus transfer with a cause, and stationary-pointer hover re-evaluation, and its press, drag and release delivery now honor the disabled-view contract; input_events gains the Modifiers alias; gesture cancels a recognizer whose view was disabled mid-gesture. Existing signatures are kept and new ones are additive, so no API or authority boundary moves. Pulp-only for now; the next re-export carries the additions.
tests: pulp build --target pulp-test-group-view-host, then run build/test/pulp-test-group-view-host "[disabled],[modifiers],[focus],[hover]"
